label: fs-20260925-v2-c5c-a0-control-trn22-r2
reason: The pinned A0 launcher checks free space before spawning its guard and the pinned guard handles owned-child cleanup and postflight, but neither contains a continuous root-free-space monitor. The prior r1 external intermittent monitoring observed its first sub-floor value only after native compile had already crossed the immutable 6.5-GiB floor. A read-only observer measures optimizer boundaries, not root space or guard stopping. No independently reviewed host-local A0 disk monitor and authenticated guard-stop mechanism was identified for r2.

required_new_gate.stop_target: Only the authenticated owned guard, so its existing signal handler and scoped postflight run
required_new_gate.on_monitor_error: Fail closed; stop the authenticated owned guard and mark the run failed, preserving logs and artifacts
required_new_gate.approval: Separate Implementer package plus independent Verifier PASS before any one-shot Supervisor authorization

next_action: Hold A0 r2, preserve exact source/score gates, prepare and independently verify a host-local disk monitor, then issue a new separate exact-SHA one-attempt authorization after another fresh live preflight.
